title: Best-of-Both Worlds for linear contextual bandits with paid observations
abstract: arXiv:2510.07424v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits with paid observations, where at each round the learner observes a context, selects an action, and may pay a fixed cost to observe feedback from a subset of arms. We propose two Follow-the-Regularized-Leader algorithms with Best-of-Both-Worlds guarantees. The first, Agg-SPB, extends the SPB-matching framework of Tsuchiya and Ito (2024) by aggregating context-dependent stability terms, achieving the characteristic $T^{2/3}$ adversarial regret rate and logarithmic dependence on $T$ in stochastic environments. The second, CE-SPB, combines arm-dependent observation probabilities with an entropy-adaptive learning rate inspired by Kuroki et al. (2024). It achieves an entropy-adaptive $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ adversarial guarantee and polylogarithmic stochastic regret, while avoiding the minimum-context-mass dependence arising in the stochastic analysis of Agg-SPB. translated_title: 付费观测下线性上下文老虎机的两全其美（Best-of-Both-Worlds）
translated_abstract: 我们研究带有付费观测的线性上下文老虎机问题，其中在每一轮中，学习者观察一个上下文，选择一个动作，并可以支付固定成本来观察来自部分臂的反馈。我们提出了两种具有“两全其美”保证的正则化领导者跟随算法。第一种是 Agg-SPB，它通过聚合与上下文相关的稳定性项，扩展了 Tsuchiya 和 Ito（2024）的 SPB-matching 框架，在对抗性环境中实现了特征的 $T^{2/3}$ 遗憾率，并在随机环境中实现了对 $T$ 的对数级依赖。第二种是 CE-SPB，它将依赖于臂的观测概率与受 Kuroki 等人（2024）启发的熵自适应学习率相结合，实现了熵自适应的 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 对抗性保证和多对数级的随机遗憾，同时避免了 Agg-SPB 随机分析中出现的最小上下文质量依赖。两种算法均进一步扩展到带污染观测的场景。
tldr: 提出了 Agg-SPB 和 CE-SPB 两种“两全其美”的正则化领导者跟随算法，用于带付费观测的线性上下文老虎机，在对抗环境中达到 $T^{2/3}$ 遗憾率，在随机环境中达到对数或多对数级遗憾。
